capabilities: Log an expense from a sidebar form
Save each expense as a note with date, category, amount and location
Carry the location over between entries
Generate a summary table that totals expenses by day and month
Customize categories, folder and property names
extras: README is written in both English and Chinese; folder and property names are configurable so expenses can match an existing note setup.
problem: Recording a purchase in Obsidian normally means creating a note and filling in properties by hand, which is slow for frequent small expenses.
summary: Sidebar form that logs an expense as a note with date, category, amount and location, plus a Bases summary table of totals.
